Vaishali Ragi
Phone: +91-9000987956 — vaishali.ragi66@gmail.com — LinkedIn — GitHub
EDUCATION
VNR Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology
CGPA: 9.50/10.0
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
2024–2028
PROJECTS
Civix — Civic Micro-Task Platform
• Built a civic issue reporting platform with AI validation and automated workflows for tracking
public problems.
• Developed task submission, validation pipelines, and automation flows for resolution tracking.
• Won 1st Place — Webathon 4.0 Hackathon. Project Link
SmartTaskFlow — Intelligent Task Automation System
• Developed an automation system that converts natural language tasks (voice/text) into exe-
cutable n8n workflows.
• Implemented LLM-based extraction to identify actions, recipients, and communication channels.
• Integrated Gmail API and Telegram Bot API with a React frontend. GitHub
Police Hospital Digital Healthcare System
React.js, Node.js, MongoDB
• Contributed to debugging and stabilization of a healthcare management system digitizing hos-
pital workflows for police departments.
• Resolved issues across modules including token-based patient registration, diagnostics (X-ray,
tests, scans), and medicine inventory systems.
• Improved reliability of role-based access for admin, employee, and institute logins.
SKILLS
Languages: C, C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript
Frontend: HTML, CSS, React.js, Next.js, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap
Backend & Databases: Node.js, FastAPI, MongoDB, Mongoose, PostgreSQL
Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, n8n, MERN Stack,PowerBI
AI: AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, Automation Workflows
CERTIFICATIONS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
• Agentic AI (Semester-long Course) — P. Sai Teja, VNRVJIET, Hyderabad (2025)
• 1st Place — Webathon 4.0, 24-hour hackathon for building Civix civic micro-task platform
• Finalist — Solution Sprint Hackathon
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
• Member — Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE), VNRVJIET
• Member — Stentorian, VNRVJIET
LANGUAGES
English, Telugu, Hindi
